title: Summer on the Hill
setting: A green hill by the sea, with a farm, trees and fields.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

sentences.en: In summer, Ben and Mia walk up a hill.
sentences.zh: 夏天，本和米娅走上一座小山。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) walk up a green hill under a bright summer sun.

sentences.en: Below them, men fish in the beautiful sea.
sentences.zh: 在他们下方，人们在美丽的海里捕鱼。
sentences.scene_prompt: From the hilltop, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) look down at fishermen in a small boat on a beautiful blue sea.

sentences.en: A plane flies north over the blue water.
sentences.zh: 一架飞机飞过蓝色的海面向北飞去。
sentences.scene_prompt: A plane flies high over the blue sea while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) point at it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a plane over the sea; the direction 'north' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sheep and cows eat grass under a tree.
sentences.zh: 绵羊和奶牛在一棵树下吃草。
sentences.scene_prompt: White sheep and brown cows eat grass under a big tree on the hill.

sentences.en: A brown rabbit runs past their feet.
sentences.zh: 一只棕色的兔子从他们脚边跑过。
sentences.scene_prompt: A brown rabbit runs past the feet of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) on the grass.

sentences.en: Near the farm, a cat watches a mouse.
sentences.zh: 农场附近，一只猫盯着一只老鼠。
sentences.scene_prompt: A cat crouches and watches a small mouse near a farm wall.

sentences.en: Ben shows his toy monkey to the sheep.
sentences.zh: 本把他的玩具猴子给绵羊看。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) holds up a toy monkey in front of a curious sheep, Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) laughing.

sentences.en: In autumn, all the flowers on the hill die.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，山上的花全都凋谢了。
sentences.scene_prompt: The same hill in autumn, with dry brown flowers and orange leaves.
